invalidSchema.description: {{path}} is not a valid schema, so the variables and files cannot be read. Fix these first:

variables.lead: Every variable of the schema, with its spec and its value in each env file.

statusHint.missing: Not set in a file that lists it
statusHint.drift: A file that lists it does not have the key yet

variables.emptySchema: The schema declares no variables yet.

drawer.notInFiles: No env file lists this variable.

protected.title: Protected
protected.explain: configure-env keeps this value: an edit changes it only when it replaces it on purpose.

copy.group: Copy the {{group}} group of {{file}} as dotenv

conflict.title: {{file}} changed since you opened it
conflict.description: Something else wrote the file after the portal read it, so your value of {{name}} was not saved.

actions.protected: {{name}} is protected; this replaces its value on purpose.

generate.confirmBody: A new random value replaces the one {{file}} has. Nobody sees it; reveal it to read it.
generate.done: Generated a new value for {{name}} in {{file}}

unset.confirmBody: The line of {{name}} is removed from {{file}}.

schemaEditor.lead: Add, change, reorder and remove the variables and files of {{path}}. Each edit is shown as a diff first, and the API checks the whole schema before it writes anything.
schemaEditor.error: The schema could not be loaded: {{message}}

variables.label: Variables in schema order
variables.empty: The schema declares no variables yet.
variables.orderChanged: The order changed. Review it to save it.

files.label: Files the schema manages
files.empty: The schema lists no files yet.

remove.noReferences: Nothing else in the schema names {{name}}.
remove.references_one: {{count}} place names {{name}}. That reference is removed with it, so nothing is left pointing at a variable that no longer exists:
remove.references_other: {{count}} places name {{name}}. Those references are removed with it, so nothing is left pointing at a variable that no longer exists:
remove.fileKeeps: The env file itself stays on disk; configure-env stops managing it.
remove.orphans_one: This variable is in no other file, so no file will hold it:
remove.orphans_other: These variables are in no other file, so no file will hold them:
remove.noOrphans: Every variable it holds is in another file too.

review.description: The change to {{path}}, as the API will check it. Nothing is written until you save.
review.invalid: The edit would make the schema invalid, so it cannot be saved:
review.stale: {{path}} changed since you opened it. The diff now shows your edit on top of the schema as it is now; review it again before saving.
review.refused: The API refused the edit; nothing was written. The form shows why.
review.refusedHere: The API refused the edit; nothing was written:
review.partial: The changes to {{name}} were saved, but renaming it to {{to}} failed. The review now shows the rename alone; save again to retry it.
review.partialFailed: The changes to {{name}} were saved, but renaming it to {{to}} failed: {{message}}. The review now shows the rename alone; save again to retry it.
review.partialRefused: Saved the changes to {{name}}, but the API refused the rename to {{to}}. The form shows why.
review.refusedRename: The API refused the rename to {{to}}:

variableForm.description: Every option env.schema.json takes for a variable. The edit is shown as a diff before anything is written.
variableForm.name: Name
variableForm.nameHint: Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.
variableForm.rename_one: Renaming rewrites the {{count}} place that names {{name}}:
variableForm.rename_other: Renaming rewrites the {{count}} places that name {{name}}:
variableForm.groupHint: A heading that groups related variables: pick one or type a new one.
variableForm.commentHint: Written as # lines above the key in generated files; may span lines.
variableForm.secretHint: Masked in output and never echoed in errors.
variableForm.protectedHint: Once a file holds a value, it is never replaced or removed without --replace-protected. No effect on templates.
variableForm.protectedNeedsSecret: Only a secret can be protected: turn on Secret first.
variableForm.protectedReasonHint: Shown in the error when someone tries to replace the value.
variableForm.defaultHint: The value used when none is given.
variableForm.exampleHint: A sample value shown to people.
variableForm.requiredUnlessHint: The variable is required unless one of these is set. Not with Required.
variableForm.conflictsWithHint: The variable and any of these must not both be set.
variableForm.distinctFromHint: When the variable and one of these are both set, their values must differ.
variableForm.filesHint: Files that take every variable ("*") hold it already.
variableForm.noFiles: Every file takes every variable, so each one holds it already.

typeOptions.none: A {{type}} variable takes no other options.
typeOptions.patternHint: A JavaScript regular expression in Unicode mode, like ^sk_[a-z0-9]+$.
typeOptions.patternMessageHint: The error shown when a value does not match the pattern.
typeOptions.testerHint: Type a value to see whether the pattern accepts it. It is never saved.
typeOptions.noMatch: The pattern does not match this value.
typeOptions.encodingHint: The value must be bytes in this encoding: base64 with padding, base64url without, or hex.
typeOptions.bytesHint: How many bytes the value must decode to; needs an encoding.
typeOptions.valuesHint: The values the variable accepts, in the order they are offered.
typeOptions.protocolsHint: The URL schemes accepted, like https, separated by commas; any scheme when empty.
typeOptions.withinHint: A cidr variable: when both are set, the value must lie inside its network.
typeOptions.noCidr: The schema has no other cidr variable to pick.
typeOptions.familyHint: The address family the block must be.
typeOptions.strictHint: Refuse a block with host bits set, like 10.0.0.1/8: the address must be the network address.
typeOptions.switchDescription: {{type}} does not take these, so they are cleared:

fileForm.description: Every option env.schema.json takes for a file. The edit is shown as a diff before anything is written.
fileForm.pathHint: Relative to the project root, with forward slashes; no .. segments and no absolute path.

generate.label: generate
generate.description: Rewrite the whole file from the schema on every apply.

merge.label: merge
merge.description: Append the keys it misses and keep everything else as it is.

create-only.label: create-only
create-only.description: Write it only when it does not exist yet; never touch it after.

fileForm.modeHint: The file permissions as three octal digits, like 600; left as they are when empty.
fileForm.everyVariableHint: Holds every variable in declaration order ("*"), new ones included.
fileForm.addVariable: Add a variable to the file
fileForm.noVariablesLeft: Every variable is in the list.
fileForm.listLabel: Variables of the file, in output order
fileForm.listEmpty: No variables yet: add them above.
fileForm.headerHint: Written as # lines at the top of the file; may span lines.
fileForm.templateHint: A template is committed with placeholders and takes only its values and the defaults, never a value a person or the environment gives.
fileForm.valuesHint: Literal values for this file that replace the defaults, like placeholders in an example file. Written after KEY= as is.
fileForm.commentsHint: Comments for this file that replace the variables' own comment.

files.lead: Each env file the schema lists: its policy, mode and drift. Open one to see its entries and its raw text.
files.empty: The schema lists no files yet.

detail.caption: The variables {{path}} lists, in order
detail.unknown: Keys in the file the schema does not list
detail.rawMissing: {{path}} does not exist yet; apply creates it.
detail.rawError: The raw text could not load: {{message}}
detail.badLine: Line {{line}} is not a valid entry

events.changed_one: {{paths}} changed outside the portal; the views show it now.
events.changed_other: {{paths}} changed outside the portal; the views show them now.

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: Write the env files the schema describes, as configure-env apply does.
apply.descriptionFiles: Write {{files}} as the schema describes it, as configure-env apply does.

values.lead: The values the files take. Defaults are filled in; an optional value left empty takes its default.
values.label: Value of {{name}}

plan.nothing: Every file is current; there is nothing to write.

reason.exists: Create-only and already there: it is never overwritten.

plan.stale: The files changed since the plan was shown. This is the plan now; nothing was written.

check.lead: The drift report of configure-env check, by file. Each item links to its variable and fixes in place: set the value, or apply the file.
check.passing: Every env file matches the schema.

item.absent: The file does not exist yet
item.differs: Its content differs from what apply writes
item.line: Line {{line}} is not a valid entry
